## isva-p05-v44 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** Granted — then what, for the freed?

**Premises.**
- If thus (iti cet).
- Even on completion, even in purpose (tat samāptau api puruṣārthe api).
- Toward him — the freed spirit (taṃ prati).

**Inference.** The grant suspends; the blow lands in v45.


### Open
- Protasis suspends; apodosis lands in v45.
